title: delete_scheduled_message removes the row locally as soon as the send leaves, before TDLib answers
trigger: Delete a scheduled message while the delete will fail (offline, already sent)
effect: The row vanishes from the dialog, the delete fails or is rejected, and the message reappears only on the next load; no error shows
fix: Mark the row Deleting(request) and remove it on the answer, restore on error

title: swipe_reply_start is a one-shot slot nothing clears on release outside a row, chat change or window
trigger: Press on a message row, release outside any row, then press-drag from empty space onto the same row and release more than 24px left of the old press point
effect: The stale (chat, message, x) is taken by the later mouse-up on that row and starts a reply nobody swiped
fix: A Swipe stage owned by the gesture (Idle/Pressed{row,x}) reset on mouse-up anywhere (window-level up listener) and on chat change

title: StorageScroll::Requested is set whether or not Settings opened, and leave_data_storage never resets the stage
trigger: open_local_storage while open_settings returns early (agent injection guard) or the page is left while the stage is Requested/WaitingSettled; later open Data & Storage normally
effect: The next visit scrolls straight to the storage usage rows although the person did not ask
fix: Set Requested only from the page's own arrival path, and reset the stage in leave_data_storage

title: The auto-download presets fetch is three facts: Seed::InFlight, auto_download_presets Fetch, and requests.has_purpose
trigger: Open Data & Storage with no data_storage.json
effect: No bug today (error returns Seed to Unseeded), but the page reads Seed::is_in_flight for 'Loading download settings' and the fetch guard reads Seed plus has_purpose, while the error line reads the Fetch: three places that must change together
fix: Derive the seeded/in-flight view from auto_download_presets (Fetch<Presets>) only

title: auto_download_answer is a single last-answer slot read by the Saving editor
trigger: Two setAutoDownloadSettings answers (less-data toggle sends three, then an editor Save) land in one ingest before the poll drains
effect: The slot holds only the last answer, never cleared; if the editor's request is not the last, StorageEditor::Saving never sees its id and stays Saving (Back is the only way out)
fix: Answers keyed by RequestId (take(request)) like dialog_answers

title: LinkOp is reset by hand from the form's Cancel button (and in start_folder_link_form) instead of by its own transitions
trigger: Edit a link, press Save, press Cancel while the request is out
effect: op goes to Idle with the request dropped; the answer lands nowhere, so a failed save shows no line and a successful one gives no confirmation
fix: one stage enum for the box (List / Edit / Saving{request, back_to}) whose Cancel transition owns the request

title: CopyMark::Copied names a timer by Instant while the timer task is .detach()ed
trigger: Copy a link in the Share Folder box
effect: The mark clears only if the detached task still finds the same Instant; the task is not held in the stage, so closing and reopening the box within 2 s leaves a task running against the new box (it matches nothing and does nothing)
fix: hold the timer Task inside CopyMark::Copied { link, _timer } so dropping the stage cancels it

title: A send refused before the request (chats_path_active false) leaves the Fetch idle: the Share box, the Delete box and the Add to folder box say 'Loading...' with no error or Retry
trigger: Open Share Folder / Delete shared folder / Add to folder while auth is not Ready or shutdown has begun
effect: fetch_folder_share, fetch_chat_folder_chats_to_leave and fetch_chat_lists_to_add_chat return Err(InvalidRequest) before begin()/fail(); the Fetch stays Idle so the box waits forever (Delete stays disabled, line 300 of folders/mod.rs) until it is cancelled
fix: mark the Fetch Failed on every Err return, including the early guard

title: Search, attach-bot and toggle answers are matched by bot id, not the RequestId of the wait
trigger: Two named-app links of the same bot opened in quick succession (or an attach-bot link twice)
effect: The older searchWebApp answer, stored under the same bot id, is taken by the newer wait, so the newer launch uses the older app's skip_confirmation / request_write_access. take_search_for(asked), take_attach_bot_for(asked) and take_add_for(bot) compare the bot id; the LaunchFlow stage does not hold the RequestId it sent. The mailbox slots found/attachment_menu_bot carry no request id
fix: Hold the RequestId in each LaunchFlow wait variant and carry it in the session answer; apply only when equal

title: baseline: MiniAppWindow::closing_confirmation is listed in the baseline and the allow list
trigger: None; the app sets it with web_app_setup_closing_behavior
effect: The field is allowed with a reason in implicit-state-allow.txt, so the baseline line is stale. scripts/implicit-state-baseline.txt still has MiniAppWindow::closing_confirmation
fix: Remove the baseline line (the allow entry covers it)

title: The mini-app poll is a fixed 30 ms timer that also runs while the window is hidden or in the background
trigger: Open a mini app and minimise or switch away; leave it open
effect: The main thread wakes about 33 times a second for as long as the app is open (and the whole time a launch waits), while the rest of Quill sleeps on wake::Signal; helper events arrive on an mpsc channel that nothing pokes. ensure_mini_app_poll loops on timer(30ms) while window.is_some() || flow.is_waiting() || pending
fix: Poke a wake::Signal from the helper reader thread and the session answer path, and sleep on it
